info.title: v2.media.get_video_upload_result
info.description: Use this API to retrieve the current status and result of a video upload task. You can also use video_upload_result_push to get notified immediately when a video upload reaches a final status (SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or CANCELLED).

get.description: Use this API to retrieve the current status and result of a video upload task. You can also use video_upload_result_push to get notified immediately when a video upload reaches a final status (SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or CANCELLED).

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/media/get_video_upload_result?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp&video_upload_id=sg-11110201-6kh48-mepm7a0ttcw3c3',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Current status of the upload task. Possible values: - INITIATED: Upload task has been created (via init_video_upload) but no parts have been uploaded yet. - UPLOADING: Video file parts are being uploaded. The upload has started but is not yet completed. - UPLOADED: All video parts have been uploaded successfully, waiting for complete_video_upload to trigger processing. - PROCESSING: Video is being transcoded/validated by the system (duration, format, resolution checks). - SUCCEEDED: Video upload and transcoding completed successfully. Video URL and cover URL are available for use. - FAILED: Upload or processing failed (e.g., invalid format, duration not within allowed range, transcoding error). - CANCELLED: Upload task was explicitly canceled by the client (cancel_video_upload), and the video is discarded.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reason
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Detailed fail or cancel reason, will be returned if status is FAILED or CANCELLED.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: update_time
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: The time of video status updates.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: video_info
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Transcoded video info, will be returned if status is SUCCEEDED.
